kicker: EQUITY RESEARCH  |  INSTITUTIONAL DEEP DIVE  |  JAPAN REAL ESTATE
title: Tokyo Tatemono Co., Ltd.
subtitle: TSE Prime: 8804  |  Bloomberg: 8804 JP  |  Real estate development & leasing
tagline: Leverage, not value, explains the discount
thesis: **Cheap only on equity multiples.** 10.3x P/E, 1.10x P/B and 0.65x NAV, but EV/Sales sits exactly on the peer regression line and EV/EBITDA (17.7x) is above its own five-year range.
**Execution is strong.** Record FY2025 operating profit (¥95.8bn); FY2026 guidance raised to OP ¥105.5bn / NI ¥65.0bn; 2025–27 plan targets reached a year early.
**Debt is the swing factor.** Net debt ¥1.44tn after a ¥191bn 1H build; BOJ at 1.25%; ~54% of FY2024–26E operating-profit growth is absorbed below the operating line.
**Event angle.** No activist yet, but a passive register (≈44% custodians), thin Fuyo support and 0.65x NAV fit the activist template; takeout zone ¥4,170–4,820.
**Triggers.** Buy below ~¥3,000 or on proof of 2H sales and year-end debt back near ¥1.40tn; Sell if 10-yr JGB > 3.25% or D/E > 2.6x.
